name: MAGIC Gamma Telescope Cherenkov Event Benchmark
description: The MAGIC Gamma Telescope dataset simulates the registration of high-energy gamma rays and background hadronic showers in ground-based atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes. Comprising 19,020 Monte Carlo simulated events (12,332 gamma rays and 6,688 hadronic background events) described by 10 continuous Hillas ellipse parameters.
